scripts.docker:down: docker compose --env-file deploy/docker/.env -f deploy/docker/docker-compose.yaml -f deploy/docker/docker-compose.build.yaml down
scripts.docker:build: docker compose --env-file deploy/docker/.env -f deploy/docker/docker-compose.yaml -f deploy/docker/docker-compose.build.yaml up --build -d --wait
scripts.docker:dev: docker compose --env-file deploy/docker/.env -f deploy/docker/docker-compose.yaml -f deploy/docker/docker-compose.dev.yaml up --build -d --wait
